text:
sophie: quick brain dump  debating layout for org Usage & Billing: narrow left rail vs a compact top rail + bottom action sheet for invoices/exports. aim: let charts breathe but keep exports discoverable.
jamal: left rail gives great pin/filter affordance. bottom sheet is interesting for actions  non-blocking and mobile-friendly.
kevin: bottom sheet is neat for mobile, but desktop patterns feel odd unless it slides from the right. prefer left rail on >=1200px, bottom sheet on mobile.
maria: accessibility flags: if using a bottom sheet, treat it like a dialog (role=dialog) and trap focus; announce via aria-live for screen readers. also provide a skip link to main charts when rail exists.
sophie: agreed re: aria. also microcopy: "Download invoice" alone causes PDF assumptions. propose primary menu "Download invoice" -> [PDF, CSV, Line items]. show file size estimate next to each option.
joah: (noah): small copy nit: change labels from "Tokens" to "Compute tokens (units)" in the breakdown so finance folks aren't confused.
jamal: charts: org-level = stacked area with large y-axis; per-project = inline sparklines next to project rows. keeps trends and comparison.
kevin: sparkline height 24px on rows, stacked area 160-200px. add reduced-motion fallback for transitions.
maria: colorblindness: use patterns (dots/diagonal) + color; legend must be toggleable. current palette fails AA at 11px.
sophie: keyboard shortcuts: allow `g` then `b` open billing; `Shift+P` toggle scope panel. panel toggles need visible focus state and aria-expanded.
joah: export analytics: event names: billing.export.open, billing.export.format_selected, billing.invoice.downloaded with payload {format, org_id}.
kevin: invoice modal: trap focus, title format "Invoice YYYY-MM  - Redwood Inference", include aria-describedby listing included assets (totals, line items, taxes).
maria: invoice download menu benefit: if user chooses CSV frequently, default next time. but also include an explicit "Always use PDF" toggle in org settings.
jamal: discovery: if bottom sheet hidden on desktop, add a sticky floating export button near charts. keeps CTA visible without stealing layout.
sophie: design-bot uploaded frames: https://figma.com/file/new-billing-patterns  includes left-rail desktop, compact top-rail + bottom-sheet mobile, and floating CTA variant.
design-bot: Note: added accessibility checklist, aria snippets, and sample analytics payloads to file comments.
kevin: prototype plan: left rail desktop + floating CTA desktop; bottom sheet for small widths; will include keyboard nav and reduced-motion in the prototype. aiming EOD.
maria: I'll prepare contrast adjustments, pattern swatches, and aria copy.
jamal: I'll draft analytics and event goals, and mock the floating CTA behavior.
sophie: action items summarized: kevin - prototype + keyboard/reduced-motion; maria - patterns + aria copy; jamal - analytics + floating CTA flows; noah - microcopy for tokens & invoice labels. 20m sync tomorrow to review clickable. :calendar:
